lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines visible on the lateral torso; spacing is relatively uniform through the mid-section, narrowing slightly as lines approach the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A minor Y-shaped bifurcation is observed at the dorsal origin of the 5th and 6th lines (counting from anterior); additional minor merging of segments observed at the ventral margin of the 10th line.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 9, 11, and 12 exhibit significant dashing, terminating at the mid-flank rather than extending to the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: High-contrast cluster of 4 distinct white spots located on the lower haunch, approximately midway between the spine and the hock.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two white spots on the upper hind limb align horizontally, following the contour of the leg muscle.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking across the nasal bridge and two distinct white spots inferior to the ocular orbit; high-contrast white 'stocking' patches visible on the lower forelimbs.
